nodes.text:
Two cases of HMPV have been detected in Karnataka, the Indian Council of Medical Research (ICMR) confirmed. The cases emerged during routine surveillance for respiratory viral pathogens, part of ICMR’s efforts to track respiratory illnesses nationwide.
